$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKG (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Ghisonaccia Alzitone

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: ATS: NIL. The chart header prints these units to call, which are not services of this aerodrome (its air-air frequency apart): .
Restricted use AD to Corsica based ACFT and to Administration ACFT.

Otherwise, stopover possible with PPR 72 HR open time sent to AD operator by email: ppr@aerodromedeghisonaccia.com AD prohibited to aircraft of mass exceeding 5.7 t without a formal prior approval from the AD operator, including for state ACFT.
AD prohibited at night including for State aircraft; AD is available at night in case of emergency.
Simultaneous use of RWY 18/36 and of the drop zone is prohibited except for ACFT based at LFKG and restricted to precision parachuting activities.

Flight plans and flight authorization submitted to the duty officer of the Military Control Center of Air Base 126 TEL: 04 95 56 85 96 - 06 22 01 23 87 TWY A available for code A ACFT TWY B available for code B ACFT.
Helicopter activity in or out of ground effect prohibited outside of paved RWY.
HEL approach prohibited on apron and hangar vicinity.
Helicopters must translate via TWY B.
Helicopters must park on the HEL apron except specific authorization from AD operator.
Parachuting (NR 406): see AIP ENR 5.5.
Aerobatics (NR 7002), RWY center line centered on ARP on 1,5 NM long, 1650 ft AMSL / 3500 ft AMSL, SRSS outside LF-R 65 activation, or prior permission of LF-R 65 operating authority.
Aerobatics activity reserved for pilots with "aerobatics" authorization on their pilot license and with authorization from PEGAASUS (managing authority) (ENR 5.5).

Autre cas, escale possible avec PPR 72 heures ouvrées à l'exploitant AD par courriel : ppr@aerodromedeghisonaccia.com AD interdit à tout aéronef de masse supérieure à 5,7 t sans autorisation préalable formelle de l'exploitant y compris les ACFT d'état.
AD interdit de nuit y compris les ACFT d'État sauf urgence.
L'utilisation simultanée de la piste 18/36 et de la zone de sauts est interdite sauf pour les aéronefs basés LFKG et limitée à des activités de parachutages de précision.

Prévol et autorisation de vol soumises au chef de quart du Centre militaire de contrôle de la Base aérienne 126 TEL : 04 95 56 85 96 - 06 22 01 23 87 Procédures et consignes particulières TWY A utilisable pour ACFT code A.
Activité hélicoptère en travail sol et hors effet de sol interdite en dehors de la piste revêtue.
Approches hélicoptères interdites sur parking et proximité hangar.
Translations hélicoptères impératives par le TWY B.
Stationnement hélicoptères obligatoire sur PRKG hélicoptère sauf autorisation particulière de l'exploitant.
Parachutage (N° 406) : voir AIP ENR 5.5.
Voltige (N° 7002), axe de la piste de longueur 1,5 NM centré sur ARP, 1650 ft AMSL/3500 ft AMSL, SR-SS hors activation LF-R 65, ou accord préalable du gestionnaire de LF-R65.
Voltige réservée aux pilotes titulaires d'une autorisation "voltige" inscrite sur la licence de navigant et autorisée par le gestionnaire PEGAASUS (ENR 5.5).
